name: MOPOP Youth Advisory Board (YAB)
what_you_do: Help shape the museum's teen programs. Work with local musicians, artists and curators, screen Sound Off! music showcase entries, help run events like the Science Fiction + Fantasy Short Film Festival, and make social media posts.
who_can_apply: Students ages 15 to 18. You may serve for up to three years.
pay_detail: The page does not say if members are paid or if there is a cost.
duration: Meets every other week during the school year; up to three years
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page gives no date for the next call.
how_to_apply: Watch the YAB page for the next application. Questions go to YAB@MOPOP.org.
notes: The page does not say when the next call opens or whether members are paid. Email YAB@MOPOP.org to ask.
